caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a pitcher made of metal, with a round, bulbous body and a wide, flared base. It has a curved spout at the top and a large, ornate handle that is attached from the top near the rim to the middle section of the body. The pitcher is primarily colored in shades of gray and appears to reflect light, giving it a metallic appearance. The surface is smooth with subtle shading to suggest its three-dimensional form. The background is plain, off-white or beige, with no other objects or designs present, allowing the pitcher to stand out centrally in the composition.
title: Pewter Pitcher
